title: Colours
description: Describe and choose things by colour.

questions.sentence: Akax kon rongor?
options: Akax neela.
Akax ronga.
Akax kola.
questions.correctAnswer: Akax neela.
questions.translatedSentence: The sky is blue.

questions.sentence: Saah bagisar pat seujia.
options: The tea garden leaves are green.
The tea garden leaves are yellow.
The tea garden flowers are green.
questions.correctAnswer: The tea garden leaves are green.

questions.sentence: Gamosa khon kon rongor?
options: Gamosa khon boga aru ronga.
Gamosa khon kola aru neela.
Gamosa khon seujia aru halodhiya.
questions.correctAnswer: Gamosa khon boga aru ronga.
questions.translatedSentence: The gamosa is white and red.

questions.sentence: Rati akax kola hoi.
options: At night the sky turns black.
At night the sky turns blue.
At night the sky is very big.
questions.correctAnswer: At night the sky turns black.

questions.sentence: Apuni kon rong bhal pai?
options: Moi neela rong bhal pao.
Moi Jorhat oloi jao.
Moloi ekakup saah lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi neela rong bhal pao.
questions.translatedSentence: I like the colour blue.

questions.sentence: Doi tu boga.
options: The curd is white.
The rice is white.
The curd is fresh.
questions.correctAnswer: The curd is white.

questions.sentence: Phul tu kon rongor?
options: Phul tu halodhiya.
Phul tu bor dangor.
Phul tu ghor ot ase.
questions.correctAnswer: Phul tu halodhiya.
questions.translatedSentence: The flower is yellow.

questions.sentence: Moi ronga rong bhal pao.
options: I like the colour red.
I like the colour black.
I want a red flower.
questions.correctAnswer: I like the colour red.

questions.sentence: Eito boga sart ne kola sart?
options: Eito boga sart.
Eito ronga gamosa.
Eito kola juta.
questions.correctAnswer: Eito boga sart.
questions.translatedSentence: This is a white shirt.

questions.sentence: Apunar sart tu kon rongor?
options: Mor sart tu neela rongor.
Mor ghoror duar tu neela.
Moi sart tu dukan ot kinilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Mor sart tu neela rongor.
questions.translatedSentence: My shirt is blue.

questions.sentence: Mor gamosa khon boga, kintu tar dhar ronga.
options: My gamosa is white, but its border is red.
My gamosa is red, but its border is white.
My gamosa is white and it is very old.
questions.correctAnswer: My gamosa is white, but its border is red.

questions.sentence: Tumar bag tu kon rongor?
options: Mor bag tu kola rongor.
Mor bag tu ghorot ase.
Moi bag tu Guwahati ot kinilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Mor bag tu kola rongor.
questions.translatedSentence: My bag is black.

questions.sentence: Eito gari khon ronga rongor.
options: This car is red.
This red car is mine.
This car is very fast.
questions.correctAnswer: This car is red.

questions.sentence: Seito gos jopar pat kon rongor?
options: Seito gos jopar pat seujia.
Seito gos jopa bor dangor.
Seito gos jopa ghoror kakot ase.
questions.correctAnswer: Seito gos jopar pat seujia.
questions.translatedSentence: That tree has green leaves.

questions.sentence: Mor ghoror duar khon halodhiya rongor.
options: The door of my house is yellow.
The door of my house is closed.
My house has a yellow roof.
questions.correctAnswer: The door of my house is yellow.

questions.sentence: Kap tu kon rongor, boga ne kamola?
options: Kap tu kamola rongor.
Kap tu saah re bhorti.
Kap tu tebulor oporot ase.
questions.correctAnswer: Kap tu kamola rongor.
questions.translatedSentence: The cup is orange.

questions.sentence: Mor juta jur kola aru bor puroni.
options: My shoes are black and very old.
My shoes are black and very new.
My black bag is very old.
questions.correctAnswer: My shoes are black and very old.

questions.sentence: Apunar phone tu kon rongor?
options: Mor phone tu boga rongor.
Mor phone tu bor puroni.
Moi phone tu ghorot pahorilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Mor phone tu boga rongor.
questions.translatedSentence: My phone is white.

questions.sentence: Apunak kon rongor gamosa lage?
options: Moloi boga rongor gamosa lage.
Moloi duta gamosa lage.
Moi gamosa khon bhal pao.
questions.correctAnswer: Moloi boga rongor gamosa lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I want a white gamosa.

questions.sentence: Moloi ronga rongor tu nalage, neela rongor tu lage.
options: I do not want the red one, I want the blue one.
I do not want the blue one, I want the red one.
I want both the red one and the blue one.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not want the red one, I want the blue one.

questions.sentence: Eito duta rongor bhitorot apunak kunto lage?
options: Moloi seujia rongor tu lage.
Moi dukan tu bisari asilo.
Moloi olop saah lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Moloi seujia rongor tu lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I want the green one.

questions.sentence: Kamola rongor sart tu kiman tokar?
options: How much is the orange shirt?
How much is the yellow shirt?
Where is the orange shirt?
questions.correctAnswer: How much is the orange shirt?

questions.sentence: Dukan ot etiya ronga rong nai.
options: Tente moloi neela rongor tu diok.
Tente moloi ronga rongor tu diok.
Moi dukan tu kot ase najano.
questions.correctAnswer: Tente moloi neela rongor tu diok.
questions.translatedSentence: Then please give me the blue one.

questions.sentence: Moi neela rongor sador khon lom.
options: I will take the blue sador.
I will take the blue shirt.
I like the blue sador.
questions.correctAnswer: I will take the blue sador.

questions.sentence: Apuni kunto bisare, gadh neela ne halka neela?
options: Moi halka neela rongor tu bisaru.
Moi neela rong ekebare bhal napao.
Moi dui khon sador bisaru.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi halka neela rongor tu bisaru.
questions.translatedSentence: I want the light blue one.

questions.sentence: Apunak jodi eito rong bhal nalage, ami anto dekhuam.
options: If you do not like this colour, we will show you another one.
If you like this colour, we will show you another one.
We do not have another colour to show you.
questions.correctAnswer: If you do not like this colour, we will show you another one.

questions.sentence: Apunar lora jonor babe kon rongor kurta lage?
options: Tar babe seujia rongor kurta lage.
Tar babe ekhon nutun boi lage.
Moi kurta khon kali kinisilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Tar babe seujia rongor kurta lage.
questions.translatedSentence: He needs a green kurta.

questions.sentence: Bihu ot apuni ki pindhibo?
options: Moi boga mekhela sador pindhim.
Moi Bihu bor bhal pao.
Bihu ot ghor ot bahut manuh ahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi boga mekhela sador pindhim.
questions.translatedSentence: I will wear a white mekhela sador.

questions.sentence: Tar sart tu neela aru tar pant tu kola.
options: His shirt is blue and his trousers are black.
His shirt is black and his trousers are blue.
His blue shirt is inside his black bag.
questions.correctAnswer: His shirt is blue and his trousers are black.

questions.sentence: Tumi aji kon rongor kurta pindhisa?
options: Moi aji halodhiya kurta pindhisu.
Moi aji bahirot ulua nai.
Moi kurta khon bhal pao.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi aji halodhiya kurta pindhisu.
questions.translatedSentence: Today I am wearing a yellow kurta.

questions.sentence: Boga rongor kapur soonkale moila hoi.
options: White clothes get dirty quickly.
White clothes dry quickly.
Dirty clothes turn white quickly.
questions.correctAnswer: White clothes get dirty quickly.

questions.sentence: Moi kola sart tu pindhim ne neela tu?
options: Neela tu pindhok, apunak bhal lage.
Apuni kono sart pindha nai.
Moi kola rong ekebare bhal napao.
questions.correctAnswer: Neela tu pindhok, apunak bhal lage.
questions.translatedSentence: Wear the blue one, it suits you.

questions.sentence: Mor deuta boga gamosa khon kandhot loi.
options: My father wears the white gamosa on his shoulder.
My father keeps the white gamosa in the cupboard.
My father wears a white shirt every day.
questions.correctAnswer: My father wears the white gamosa on his shoulder.

questions.sentence: Eito ronga sador khon kar?
options: Eito mor bhonir sador.
Eito sador khon bor dangor.
Moi sador khon kali dhuisilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Eito mor bhonir sador.
questions.translatedSentence: It is my sister's sador.

questions.sentence: Tumar seujia sart tu kot ase?
options: Where is your green shirt?
Where is my green shirt?
Whose green shirt is this?
questions.correctAnswer: Where is your green shirt?

questions.sentence: Tumar juta jur kola ne motia?
options: Mor juta jur motia rongor.
Mor juta jur bor dhuniya.
Moi juta jur Guwahati ot kinisilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Mor juta jur motia rongor.
questions.translatedSentence: My shoes are brown.

questions.sentence: Brahmaputrar pani kon rongor dekha jai?
options: Barisa kalot pani tu motia rongor hoi.
Barisa kalot pani tu bor thanda hoi.
Noi khon amar ghoror kakot ase.
questions.correctAnswer: Barisa kalot pani tu motia rongor hoi.
questions.translatedSentence: In the monsoon the water looks brown.

questions.sentence: Guwahati ot bahut ghoror sat ronga rongor.
options: In Guwahati many house roofs are red.
In Guwahati many house roofs are blue.
In Guwahati many red houses are new.
questions.correctAnswer: In Guwahati many house roofs are red.

questions.sentence: Jorhator saah bagisa bur kenekua lage?
options: Bagisa bur sompurno seujia dekha jai.
Bagisa bur ghoror pora bor dur ot ase.
Moi Jorhat oloi jabo bisaru.
questions.correctAnswer: Bagisa bur sompurno seujia dekha jai.
questions.translatedSentence: The gardens look completely green.

questions.sentence: Bosonto kalot gos bur ronga phul ere bhorti hoi.
options: In spring the trees are full of red flowers.
In spring the trees are full of green leaves.
In spring the red flowers fall from the trees.
questions.correctAnswer: In spring the trees are full of red flowers.

questions.sentence: Beli dubar somoyot akaxor rong kenekua hoi?
options: Beli dubar somoyot akax kamola hoi.
Beli dubar somoyot bor gorom lage.
Rati akax bur bor dhuniya lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Beli dubar somoyot akax kamola hoi.
questions.translatedSentence: At sunset the sky turns orange.

questions.sentence: Barisar dinot akax dhuwa rongor hoi thake.
options: On rainy days the sky stays grey.
On rainy days the sky stays blue.
On rainy days it rains the whole day.
questions.correctAnswer: On rainy days the sky stays grey.

questions.sentence: Bazar ot kon rongor pasoli besi dekha jai?
options: Bazar ot seujia pasoli hei besi dekha jai.
Bazar ot manuh bor besi hoi.
Moi bazar oloi kali goisilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Bazar ot seujia pasoli hei besi dekha jai.
questions.translatedSentence: In the market you mostly see green vegetables.

questions.sentence: Amar gaon or gorubur boga aru motia rongor.
options: The cows in our village are white and brown.
The cows in our village are black and white.
Our village has many brown houses.
questions.correctAnswer: The cows in our village are white and brown.

questions.sentence: Seito sorai tu kon rongor?
options: Seito sorai tu neela aru kola rongor.
Seito sorai tu soonkale uri gol.
Moi sorai bur bor bhal pao.
questions.correctAnswer: Seito sorai tu neela aru kola rongor.
questions.translatedSentence: That bird is blue and black.

questions.sentence: Eito neela tu moloi olop besi gadh lagise.
options: Tente moi apunak olop halka tu dekhuao.
Tente moi apunak arau gadh tu dekhuao.
Moro seito rongtu ekebare bhal nalage.
questions.correctAnswer: Tente moi apunak olop halka tu dekhuao.
questions.translatedSentence: Then let me show you a slightly lighter one.

questions.sentence: Gorom kalot halka rongor kapur bhal, kiyono kola rong e gorom bosai.
options: Light coloured clothes are better in summer, because black holds the heat.
Light coloured clothes are better in winter, because black holds the heat.
Black clothes are better in summer, because they do not show dirt.
questions.correctAnswer: Light coloured clothes are better in summer, because black holds the heat.

questions.sentence: Apunak ronga takoi neela rong e besi bhal lage.
options: Dhanyavad, tente moi neela tu hei lom.
Dhanyavad, tente moi ronga tu hei lom.
Moi ajikali kono nutun kapur nikino.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyavad, tente moi neela tu hei lom.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, then I will take the blue one.

questions.sentence: Jodi eito rong tumar bhal nalage, tente moi anto khon uliai dim.
options: If you do not like this colour, then I will take out another one.
If you like this colour, then I will take out another one.
I do not like this colour, so please take out another one.
questions.correctAnswer: If you do not like this colour, then I will take out another one.

questions.sentence: Apuni kola rong besi bhal pai ne motia rong?
options: Moi kola rong besi bhal pao, kintu motia rongo bhal.
Moi duyota rong ekebare bhal napao.
Moloi ekhon kola rongor bag lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi kola rong besi bhal pao, kintu motia rongo bhal.
questions.translatedSentence: I like black more, but brown is nice too.

questions.sentence: Mor bhagini ye gulopiya rong bhal pai, kintu moi tak besi bhal napao.
options: My niece likes pink, but I do not like it much.
My niece likes pink, and I like it a lot too.
My niece does not like pink, but I like it a lot.
questions.correctAnswer: My niece likes pink, but I do not like it much.

questions.sentence: Eito sador khon dhui dile rong tu molan hoi jabo ne?
options: Nai, eito rong tu dhui dileo molan nohoi.
Hoi, eito sador khon bor dhuniya.
Moi sador khon etiya dhui asu.
questions.correctAnswer: Nai, eito rong tu dhui dileo molan nohoi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, this colour does not fade even after washing.

questions.sentence: Gadh rongor kapur soonkale moila nedekhai, kintu gorom besi lage.
options: Dark clothes do not look dirty quickly, but they feel hotter.
Dark clothes look dirty quickly, but they feel cooler.
Dark clothes are cheaper, but they get dirty quickly.
questions.correctAnswer: Dark clothes do not look dirty quickly, but they feel hotter.

questions.sentence: Apuni kiyo neela rong ito iman bhal pai?
options: Kiyono neela rong e moloi Brahmaputrar kotha monot pelai.
Kiyono moi Guwahati ot bahut bosor thakisu.
Moi neela rongor sart duta kali kinisilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Kiyono neela rong e moloi Brahmaputrar kotha monot pelai.
questions.translatedSentence: Because blue reminds me of the Brahmaputra.
